mapper.sql: FROM distribution_distributor d LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id AND m.company_id = d.company_id

WHERE d.company_id = #{f.companyId} AND d.distributor_self = 0 AND d.is_valid IN ('true', 'false')
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{f.nameLikeEscaped}, '%') ESCAPE '\\'
AND d.province LIKE CONCAT('%', #{f.provinceLikeEscaped}, '%') ESCAPE '\\'
AND d.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{f.cityLikeEscaped}, '%') ESCAPE '\\'

(6371 * ACOS(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, COS(RADIANS(#{f.userLat})) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(d.lat AS DECIMAL(18,10)))) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(d.lng AS DECIMAL(18,10))) - RADIANS(#{f.userLng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{f.userLat})) * SIN(RADIANS(CAST(d.lat AS DECIMAL(18,10)))) ))))
WHERE ((IFNULL(geo_filtered.delivery_distance, 0) > 0 AND geo_filtered.distance <= IFNULL(geo_filtered.delivery_distance, 0)) OR IFNULL(geo_filtered.delivery_distance, 0) = 0)
